fields.Name: IT95 - JSONType Live Sync
fields.Description: Live-database proof that a JSONType field's typed object accessor (GetJSONFieldObject/SetJSONFieldObject over JSONFieldBinding) is a LIVE view of the raw field. The pre-fix accessor parsed on every read, so an in-place edit mutated a throwaway copy and Save() wrote nothing. A test-only subclass of MJ: Tests adds a LiveConfig accessor over the nullable Configuration JSON column. JL1: a 12-level-deep in-place edit dirties the raw field, saves, and a FRESH load returns it. JL2: push, splice and delete persist. JL3: a reference held across Save stays live. JL4: an edit through the caller's own reference after assignment is captured by the pre-save flush. JL5: reads and no-op writes never dirty the record. JL6: after a change made elsewhere the accessor re-parses and stale references throw rather than silently dropping writes. JL7: ToPlainJSON output survives structuredClone and is independent of the entity. JL8: null to object, replacement and object to null persist. JL9: 200 nested mutations collapse into one consistent save. All checks mutate and are gated behind RUN_MUTATION_TESTS; the bundle creates, prefixes, tags and sweeps its own MJ: Tests rows. Server transport (SQL provider).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A JSONType field's typed object accessor is a live view: in-place edits at any depth persist and a fresh database load returns them.
